account_home_meta_description: How your dogs are doing, their requests and their courses, all on one page.
account_home_hero_lead: See how each dog is doing on its own card, with its next step right there.
account_home_hero_lead_empty: You haven't added a dog here yet.
account_home_no_dogs_description: Write its name and breed so {trainer} knows who to expect. Then you can ask for its free evaluation.
account_home_next_lead: Every dog takes this same road; each dog's card shows where it is now.
account_home_next_intro_line: You write its name, breed and age, and add a photo if you have one.
account_home_next_eval_line: You request it separately for each dog. {trainer} calls, and the evaluation shows which courses suit it.
account_home_next_buy_line: An evaluated dog can buy the courses whose prerequisites it has passed, at a fixed price, from the cart.
account_home_next_train_line: {trainer} calls to arrange it. Each time a course is finished, the next ones open up.
account_home_error_description: Something went wrong. Open the page again or check back in a few minutes.
